current.text: Grant is in the projected Memphis starting five at small forward, with Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey. He gets the spot as a trusted veteran.
His starting role is not secure. Memphis may go younger and bring him off the bench more often.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses an 11 or 12 man rotation and keeps minutes down. Only Boozer and Coward are expected to play more than 30 minutes, so Grant's minutes are capped.
The newest expert call says he is not worth even a last-round pick in 12-team leagues. It also calls ESPN's rank of about 147 about right.
Memphis has three first-round picks in the 2027 draft, which gives it room to make trades.
Grant is a possible trade chip at the deadline or on draft night. A trade could change his role.
He is expected to be motivated this season because he wants another big NBA contract.
His 2P% rose from 38 to 52 last season. The expert expects it to settle at about 48 to 49, which would lower his FG%.
Memphis plays 4 games in each of our playoff weeks 19, 20 and 21 (season ending March 28). It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.
Memphis is expected to be a below-average team of around 10th seed. One expert says it is not trying to tank because of the new tanking rules.

durable.text: He is a scoring-only player. He brings threes, points and a good FT%, but his rebounds, assists and steals are low for a forward, and his FG% is weak.
His profile has little room to improve. The expert compares him to Harrison Barnes.
His rim finishing usually sits in the mid-to-high 50s percent.
He has been much more available than Ja Morant, but he has missed games in March and April before.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace and uses short, hard stints.

note: Grant sits right at our 144-player cutoff: Yahoo has him at rank 168 and ESPN at 146, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he was not drafted in our league last season. The newest expert call says to skip him in 12-team leagues. Bid 1 USD at most, and only for a punt FG% build that needs about 2.4 threes, 17 points and an 82% FT%. The 4-4-4 playoff schedule is a plus. Early in the season, check whether he keeps the starting job and gets close to 30 minutes in Iisalo's deep rotation, and whether his FG% stays near the 43 to 44% projected.
